dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a continuous spline curve from the posterior insertion point to the apex, characterized by a high degree of falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex exhibits a small-radius rounded morphology, forming a narrow transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge presents a steep, convex curvature originating from the dorsal ridge at an approximate 65-degree angle relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum horizontal base width to the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular light-colored patch on the lateral surface of the dorsal fin, consistent with extensive depigmentation or epidermal scarring; multiple small notches and irregularities are visible along the posterior trailing edge near the base.
other_distinctive_markers: The large light-colored anomaly on the fin contains internal texture variations, including darker punctate spots and linear striations.
